I appreciate your perspective on this and I can agree most of what you’ve said, but I did not really see in your video or in your replies about the person who pays the ultimate price and I think that is the problem. A child pays with their life. A male child or a female child will pay the ultimate price and it is a painful one. Abortion is painful to the child in the womb and that is the true victim. The innocent defenceless baby. And ultimately, I think that abortion has become a real issue in our world today because the baby is either the last person thought about or they are not considered at all. The needs of father or the mother is counted as more important than the life of that child. That is the true evil of abortion.

I see your point clearly. Firstly, no one does abortion “casually”, people do not just wake up and say “oh let me just go have an abortion for fun.” People have abortions for so many reasons, lack of readiness, health risk (abortion doesn’t have nearly as much risk as carrying pregnancy to term), sexual violence etc. secondly, Abortion is not just a black or white thing, it’s very nuanced. Using shame and fear of sin, to coerce people to do something they would rather not do, and then they end up doing it and suffering the consequences for the rest of their life. Millions of children are suffering everyday, child labour is rampant in Nigeria, children are out of school, lack of resources to care for said children eventually leads to death of several. Nigeria is dancing at the top of the list for maternal and child mortality rates in the world, making pregnancy and childbirth in the country a bigger risk than so many other countries. Regardless of how a person became pregnant, they should have the right to decide whether or not they want to have the child, without being told they are committing a sin.

As a soon to be Medical doctor, please we doctors don't train to take lives, we are trained to save lives. In any case where there is potential loss of life, eg ectopic babies eventually die, fetus with some chromosomal abnormal eventually die or if the mother has a high chance of losing her life, that's when ethically the pregnancy is removed in medicine. So those using ectopic pregnancy to justify abortion, I hope all the abortions you're justifying are ectopic?
